rows.speaker: Shingo
rows.en: Mobile suit unit spotted ahead!
rows.display_text: 「Mobile suit unit spotted ahead!」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Whoa! That's a huge number!
rows.display_text: 「Whoa! That's a huge number!」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: The more there are, the better! Looks like a mountain of treasure to me!
rows.display_text:
「The more there are, the better! Looks
like a mountain of treasure to me!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: All right, we're launching. All units, deploy.
rows.display_text:
「All right, we're launching. All units,
deploy.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: You reinforcements too, please.
rows.display_text: 「You reinforcements too, please.」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Wait, Captain! There's a unit closing in on us at high speed!
rows.display_text:
「Wait, Captain! There's a unit closing in
on us at high speed!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: So they've come...!
rows.display_text: 「So they've come...!」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: The freak-Gundam brothers, huh!
rows.display_text: 「The freak-Gundam brothers, huh!」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: Found you, Freeden.
rows.display_text: 「Found you, Freeden.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Tiffa Adill... today, you're coming with us for certain.
rows.display_text:
「Tiffa Adill... today, you're coming with
us for certain.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Shut up! We don't have time to deal with you two today!
rows.display_text:
「Shut up! We don't have time to deal
with you two today!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: What?
rows.display_text: 「What?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: The Freeden will protect Tiffa! All units, carry out the operation!
rows.display_text:
「The Freeden will protect Tiffa! All
units, carry out the operation!」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Garrod... I'll be all right. So...
rows.display_text: 「Garrod... I'll be all right. So...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Right! I'll go clean up this junk in no time!
rows.display_text:
「Right! I'll go clean up this junk in no
time!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Also, according to our calculations, any battle lasting over five minutes will put us in the red on expenses.
rows.display_text:
「Also, according to our calculations, any
battle lasting over five minutes will put
us in the red on expenses.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: So basically, wipe out the unmanned mobile suits within five minutes and earn our target funds.
rows.display_text:
「So basically, wipe out the unmanned
mobile suits within five minutes and earn
our target funds.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Let's do this! Target funds: 450,000!!
rows.display_text: 「Let's do this! Target funds: 450,000!!」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: To ignore our very presence...
rows.display_text: 「To ignore our very presence...」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: You'll regret this, Garrod Ran...!
rows.display_text: 「You'll regret this, Garrod Ran...!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Not a chance! I'm pulling off the operation and protecting Tiffa, both!
rows.display_text:
「Not a chance! I'm pulling off the
operation and protecting Tiffa, both!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: All right! The rogue mobile suits are cleared out!
rows.display_text:
「All right! The rogue mobile suits are
cleared out!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Further fighting is pointless. I suppose we've no choice but to withdraw today...
rows.display_text:
「Further fighting is pointless. I suppose
we've no choice but to withdraw today...」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: Infuriating bunch. Don't think this will go your way next time...!
rows.display_text:
「Infuriating bunch. Don't think this will
go your way next time...!」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Kid! What's our take!?
rows.display_text: 「Kid! What's our take!?」

rows.speaker: Kid
rows.en: Funds earned: {tm}! Target cleared!
rows.display_text: 「Funds earned: {tm}! Target cleared!」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Heh heh... nailed it! Thanks to you reinforcements too!
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... nailed it! Thanks to you
reinforcements too!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Also, by my calculations, the maximum possible earnings come to 500,000 or more.
rows.display_text:
「Also, by my calculations, the maximum
possible earnings come to 500,000 or more.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Good work, everyone. Operation complete.
rows.display_text:
「Good work, everyone. Operation
complete.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Heh heh... maybe I'll use the money we earned to buy Tiffa a present or something!
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... maybe I'll use the money we
earned to buy Tiffa a present or
something!」

rows.speaker: Kid
rows.en: No good! Funds earned: {tm}! We haven't hit the target!
rows.display_text:
「No good! Funds earned: {tm}! We
haven't hit the target!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Unfortunately, we didn't reach the target on funds...
rows.display_text:
「Unfortunately, we didn't reach the
target on funds...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Let's just be glad the rogue mobile suits didn't cause any further damage.
rows.display_text:
「Let's just be glad the rogue mobile
suits didn't cause any further damage.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: So in the end, this one put us in the red...
rows.display_text:
「So in the end, this one put us in the
red...」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: That guy got away!
rows.display_text: 「That guy got away!」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Tch! If we'd finished him off completely, we could've sold the unit to a junk shop!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! If we'd finished him off
completely, we could've sold the unit to a
junk shop!」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: Looks like they gave up for today.
rows.display_text: 「Looks like they gave up for today.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: If they're going to run, they might as well leave the unit behind. It's no good for us if they get away.
rows.display_text:
「If they're going to run, they might as
well leave the unit behind. It's no good
for us if they get away.」

rows.speaker: Shingo
rows.en: N-no good, Captain! Keep fighting any longer and we'll only end up in the red!
rows.display_text:
「N-no good, Captain! Keep fighting any
longer and we'll only end up in the red!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: ...The operation's failed, but we can't just fall back and leave the unmanned mobile suits running loose...
rows.display_text:
「...The operation's failed, but we can't
just fall back and leave the unmanned
mobile suits running loose...」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Aw, man... so it ends up being volunteer work after all...
rows.display_text:
「Aw, man... so it ends up being volunteer
work after all...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Unmanned mobile suits running wild!?
rows.display_text: 「Unmanned mobile suits running wild!?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: It's likely the unmanned units the military introduced have gone berserk.
rows.display_text:
「It's likely the unmanned units the
military introduced have gone berserk.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: No way... the Flash System!?
rows.display_text: 「No way... the Flash System!?」

rows.speaker: Carris
rows.en: No... from what I've learned, it's some kind of autopilot system.
rows.display_text:
「No... from what I've learned, it's some
kind of autopilot system.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: So, don't tell me... we're the ones going to deal with it?
rows.display_text:
「So, don't tell me... we're the ones going
to deal with it?」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: That's ridiculous! Why should we be the ones cleaning up after the military!?
rows.display_text:
「That's ridiculous! Why should we be the
ones cleaning up after the military!?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: But if the unmanned units keep rampaging, it'll bring damage to residential areas too.
rows.display_text:
「But if the unmanned units keep
rampaging, it'll bring damage to residential
areas too.」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: So we're doing volunteer work, then?
rows.display_text: 「So we're doing volunteer work, then?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: This isn't charity. Whatever mobile suits we shoot down, we're the ones taking possession of them.
rows.display_text:
「This isn't charity. Whatever mobile
suits we shoot down, we're the ones
taking possession of them.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: If they're military mobile suits, they should fetch a good price even at a junk shop.
rows.display_text:
「If they're military mobile suits, they
should fetch a good price even at a junk
shop.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: So there's real profit in it after all.
rows.display_text: 「So there's real profit in it after all.」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: If that's the case, then it's settled! Let's get going already!
rows.display_text:
「If that's the case, then it's settled!
Let's get going already!」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: What a mercenary sort!
rows.display_text: 「What a mercenary sort!」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Kind of surprising, hearing the Captain talk about making money.
rows.display_text:
「Kind of surprising, hearing the Captain
talk about making money.」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: The Freeden's a Vulture crew too, so I suppose it's only natural.
rows.display_text:
「The Freeden's a Vulture crew too, so I
suppose it's only natural.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: It costs money just to keep living. We've got to eat too, after all.
rows.display_text:
「It costs money just to keep living.
We've got to eat too, after all.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Also, since this will be a large-scale operation, we've called in reinforcements. We'll carry out the operation with their cooperation.
rows.display_text:
「Also, since this is a large-scale
operation, we've called in reinforcements.
We'll proceed with their cooperation.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: So basically, make good use of the reinforcements' strength.
rows.display_text:
「So basically, make good use of the
reinforcements' strength.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What's wrong, Tiffa? Something on your mind?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Tiffa? Something on your
mind?」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Be careful, Garrod. Those two are somewhere close by...
rows.display_text:
「Be careful, Garrod. Those two are
somewhere close by...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Those two... the Frost brothers!
rows.display_text: 「Those two... the Frost brothers!」
